selectionData: 2024 only; existing 2025 evaluation is reused diagnostic evidence, not a new untouched test
freshTest: 2026 completed games, evaluated only after the 2024 calibration is frozen
ratingConfig: Use the existing 2024-selected ridge and half-life unchanged
cadence: Daily 00:00 UTC; exclude kickoffs less than 24 hours before fit
calibration: Regularized logistic mapping of signed model-line difference to home-cover or over probability, fit on 2024 walk-forward predictions only
interpretation: All conditions must pass on fresh forward evidence before a market can be called statistically qualified. A passing backtest does not guarantee future profit. Do not tune to 2025 or 2026 outcomes.
